title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for persistent low back pain.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting today for evaluation of chronic low back pain. He reports a dull, aching sensation in the lumbar region that has persisted for approximately three months. He describes the pain as constant but exacerbated by prolonged sitting and heavy lifting. He denies any radiating pain into the lower extremities, numbness, or weakness. He has tried over-the-counter ibuprofen with only mild relief.

Medication List
Ibuprofen 400mg as needed.

Exam
The patient is in no acute distress. Physical examination of the lumbar spine reveals mild tenderness to palpation over the L4-L5 paraspinal muscles. Range of motion is slightly limited in forward flexion. Neurological exam of the lower extremities is intact, with normal strength, sensation, and reflexes.

Assessment
1. Chronic low back pain.

Plan
The patient will begin a course of physical therapy twice weekly focusing on core strengthening and lumbar stretching. We discussed proper lifting techniques and ergonomics. He will follow up in four weeks to assess progress.

Problem List
1. COPD
explanations: COPD appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
